title: Act: Write store focus from BootScene.onKeyDown
summary: Call setFocusedObject after moveFocus in the keyboard handler
description: In BootScene.onKeyDown, after moveFocus, write the focused id to useGameStore via setFocusedObject, before emitting focusChange.
acceptance_criteria: Tab press leaves store focusedObjectId equal to the focused object id.
definition_of_done: onKeyDown writes store focus on Tab, Shift+Tab, arrows

steps.action: Inside the `if (delta !== 0)` branch, compute `const id = this.sceneObjects.find((o) => o.isFocused)?.spec.id ?? null;` after moveFocus, call useGameStore.getState().setFocusedObject(id), then emit focusChange with { id }.
steps.code: moveFocus(...); const id = this.sceneObjects.find((o) => o.isFocused)?.spec.id ?? null; useGameStore.getState().setFocusedObject(id); phaserToReact.emit('focusChange', { id });
steps.expected: A Tab press sets the store focusedObjectId and still emits focusChange with the same id.
